title: Create an IPEX GitHub team
content:
Note creating security groups used for access to GitHub and Azure DevOps is currently done by someone in DevOps team.

To create an IPEX team in inter-ikea GitHub organization start by navigating to team IPEX teams page.

Add the new team by giving the team name. In the following form you connect the team to the Azure AD group for team in “Select Groups“ drop down.

Note: Add yourself as member in security group before linking GitHub team to not loose the settings after linking.

You might have to get approval for creating the team.
